p: sanctuary: The whole people were witnesses to his holy majesty in adopting them, and of his mighty power in delivering them.
mountains skipped like rams: Seeing that these dead creatures felt God's power and after a sort saw it, much more his people ought to consider it, and glorify him for the same.
earth: Ought then his people to be insensible when they see his power and majesty?
turned the rock into a standing: That is, miraculously caused water to come out of the rock in great abundance, Ex 17:6.
